# Identity-matching thresholds

When matching identities, an anchor overlap score must be at least 0.5 and a name similarity score must be at least 0.8.

To ensure conservative matches that avoid merging disparate identities.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/normalize.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.normalize.Thresholds`
